objective: Close and verify the production runtime data chain before real-PI entry: real ADC -> fresh sample -> Q12 PI, and Vref engineering value -> raw reference. Keep real power / PI unlock / PWM loop disabled.

binding_design.freshness_signal: g_adc_sample_sequence (advances on every ADC conversion in ADCINT1_ISR)
binding_design.latest_sample: g_adc_vout_filtered_raw (IIR-smoothed, same raw scale; identical physical semantics to pre-migration g_vout_volts source)
binding_design.consume_rule: CTRL_RunFastControl consumes g_adc_vout_filtered_raw EXACTLY once per fresh sequence; g_control_adc_sequence_last tracks consumed seq; duplicate seq -> sample_valid=0 -> PI/integrator FREEZE; multiple samples between two ticks -> only the LATEST is consumed once
binding_design.control_vout_raw: g_control_vout_raw records the sample actually consumed by the PI at Compute entry (no slow-task refresh)
binding_design.reference_valid_gate: g_control_reference_valid set in CTRL_SlowTask ONLY when g_voltage_reference>0.5V; CTRL_FastTask early-returns while invalid -> 0V init reference can never become a real RUN reference
binding_design.reference_raw_path: g_control_vref_raw = CTRL_VoltsToRaw(g_voltage_reference) in the 5ms slow task (only source = engineering Vref), never hard-coded

20us_budget_production_binding.measurement: whole TINT0 ISR including real ADC-sequence freshness + CTRL_RunFastControl + Q12 Compute + shadow Apply
20us_budget_production_binding.threshold: <=900 PASS / 901-1080 MARGIN_LOW / >1080 FAIL / >=1200 ABS FAIL; overrun must be 0

sil.cadence_note: Q12 output quantized to integer Hz (out>>12); transient slew divergence ~17Hz (~0.016% of 150kHz) within 25Hz transient tolerance; steady-state ensemble holds 5.78Hz < 10Hz
